events.observed_signal: The full Agent Handoff bundle rejected immutable historical review V47 and decision H17 before active P50 authority could validate.

correction.action: Added a versioned migration manifest with exact Git-blob pins for V47 and H17, validated canonical V48 and H18 replacements, kept historical records visible, and prevented migrated records from acting as current authority.

checks: exact historical and replacement Git-blob SHA validation
negative tests for unlisted, mismatched, missing, invalid, circular and active-authority misuse

learning.reusable_lesson: Append-only history can remain auditable without weakening current authority when every exception and canonical replacement is exact-content pinned and denied active-authority status.
learning.future_prevention: Validate the complete append-only bundle and migration manifest before any remote mutation or provider dispatch.

events.observed_signal: Safety review rejected a generalized relaxation that could have accepted unrelated proactive Human Decisions outside the established review chain.

correction.action: Restored the default Human Decision chain rule and permitted only the exact blob-pinned H18/V48 and H19/V49 pairs listed in the migration manifest.

checks: default proactive Human Decision chain rejection retained
exact blob-pinned H18/V48 and H19/V49 acceptance
blob mismatch and unlisted pair rejection

learning.reusable_lesson: A historical exception must identify exact records and exact content; changing a general authority rule creates a wider execution surface than the migration requires.
learning.future_prevention: Prefer record-specific manifest pins over global authorization-rule exceptions and include negative tests for unrelated records.

events.observed_signal: The first authoritative-branch push could not fast-forward because the remote branch gained the P50 correction-journal schema, policy and queue revisions during local work.

correction.action: Fetched the new remote state, rebased the migration commit without force, revalidated the combined tree, and pushed the linear authoritative history.

checks: full Agent Handoff validation after rebase

learning.reusable_lesson: Concurrent coordination additions can be preserved safely by rebasing and repeating authority checks; a force push is unnecessary.
learning.future_prevention: Fetch the authoritative branch immediately before publishing each phase and re-run bundle validation whenever coordination records changed.
